mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are seeing clear skies and 65 degrees at Fireman's Park under a Waning Crescent moon, with temperatures cooling to an overnight low of 49 degrees and no rain expected.

The city has launched a new leaf vacuum truck for fall collection, so please ensure only loose leaves are placed behind the curb, while building inspectors remain available by appointment for your permit needs.
We have a full slate of activities, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, and tomorrow you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia or the Wisconsin Brewing Company quiz night.

In a notable case from October 3, a local officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle with expired registration, which resulted in the arrest of a 19-year-old man for possession of a stolen firearm.
Head over to Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist, before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
